violations.description: Sensitive files and private keys uploaded as CI/CD artifacts
violations.evidence: Uploading .env, credentials.json, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, and private keys as workflow artifacts in .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml
violations.recommendation: Exclude sensitive configuration files, environment files, and private keys from workflow artifacts.

violations.description: Hardcoded production/sensitive credentials in workflow env block
violations.evidence: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and DATABASE_PASSWORD hardcoded in job env block in .github/workflows/deploy.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and inject them securely using GitHub Actions secrets (${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}, etc.).

violations.description: Hardcoded sensitive API tokens in workflow env block
violations.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN and DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN hardcoded in job env block in .github/workflows/release.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded tokens and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

violations.description: Secrets echoed and printed to workflow logs
violations.evidence: echo statements and printenv | grep -i token printing secrets in .github/workflows/ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove debugging steps that output secrets or tokens to the workflow console logs.

violations.description: Bash debug mode (set -x / set -ex) expanding secrets in logs
violations.evidence: set -x enabled before running commands referencing sensitive environment variables in .github/workflows/deploy.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove set -x / set -ex from steps handling sensitive environment variables or secrets.

violations.description: Verbose HTTP requests (curl -v) exposing authorization headers in logs
violations.evidence: curl -v / --verbose used with authorization headers in deploy.yml and release.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove --verbose or -v flags from curl commands that include authorization headers or sensitive payloads.

violations.description: Missing top-level permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows
violations.evidence: None of the workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) define a permissions block.
violations.recommendation: Define explicit least-privilege permissions blocks at the workflow or job level.

violations.evidence: npm publish --token=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} passes secret as CLI flag in .github/workflows/ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Pass secrets via environment variables or configuration files rather than command-line arguments where they can appear in process lists.

violations.description: Publish/release job running without prerequisite test or build validation jobs
violations.evidence: release.yml runs publish job on release published without requiring a test job or dependency check
violations.recommendation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on passing test and build jobs before executing release or publish jobs.
